review_title: 5.0 out of 5 stars I Keep Coming Back to This — One of the Best Cleansers I’ve Used at Any Price
review_date: Reviewed in the United States on March 22, 2026
review_body: I’m 52 and post-menopausal, with dry, increasingly sensitive skin, and I’ve tried just about every cleanser out there—from Sulwhasoo to Medicube to La Roche-Posay and everything in between. This COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser is one I keep coming back to, and that says a lot. What makes this stand out is how balanced and consistent it is. It cleans effectively, but never feels harsh. The gel texture creates a light, gentle lather that removes what it needs to without overdoing it. My skin always feels clean, fresh, and comfortable, never tight or stripped. The low pH formula really does make a difference, especially for mature skin. It helps maintain that sense of balance and keeps my skin from feeling disrupted after cleansing. That’s something I notice immediately, especially compared to more aggressive cleansers. I use this mostly as a morning cleanse, and it’s perfect for that. It wakes up the skin, removes any overnight buildup, and leaves my face feeling refreshed without needing to “recover” afterward. That said, it also works well as a gentle second cleanse at night. What I really appreciate is that it doesn’t try to do too much. It’s not heavy, not overly active, and not complicated—it just does its job really well, and that’s exactly why it works. The texture is lightweight and easy to use, and a small amount goes a long way, so the tube lasts. For the price, it’s honestly an excellent value, especially considering how it performs compared to much more expensive cleansers. The scent is light and fresh, slightly herbal/clean, and not overpowering. It adds to the experience without being irritating. After trying so many cleansers across all price ranges, this is one that I consistently trust. It keeps my skin balanced, comfortable, and looking its best without any drama.

review_title: 5.0 out of 5 stars Best Cleanser on the Market
review_date: Reviewed in the United States on February 3, 2026
review_body: I have been using this specific face cleanser for years now, and when I have tried other cleansers, I always make my way back to this one! I have sensitive skin and some psoriasis around my nose, and I have always struggled to find a good cleanser that doesn't strip my face away, this one is perfect. First off, I love the bottle it comes in, it's soft enough to squeeze every ounce out of it, and you get A LOT of products. You really just need just a little bit to work in your palms. It has a very faint tea tree oil scent to it, which I don't mind at all, and I actually find quiet relaxing. It is a clear gel, no color to it and no weird consistency either. You can really make it nice and foamy if you work it in your palms. Every time I use this cleanser, I feel clean, refreshed and glowing. COSRX makes some pretty amazing cleansers and toners in my opinion. If you have sensitive, dry skin and are prone to flaking, try this out ASAP!!!

review_title: 5.0 out of 5 stars Gentle on Sensitive Skin!
review_date: Reviewed in the United States on May 15, 2026
review_body: I was searching for a mild PH face cleanser because I'd read an article recently about how much we're stripping natural oils away from our face with harsh cleansers. I struggle with adult acne and thought I would give this a try for my morning routine. I'm absolutely shocked with how this is working on my skin. It's not leaving my face oily or unwashed, and I've seen a reduction in my outbreaks after over a month of using this product. I have sensitive skin as well and I haven't had any adverse reactions to this product. It lathers really well, which was surprising for me, and washes off. It has a slight scent but isn't overbearing, and I don't smell it on my skin post-shower. You don't need much to get a solid cleanse, so this will last you a while. These are really key details for me when shopping for a soap or skin-product. Overall, I highly recommend this product.
